title: Solution Architect
description:
Role Description

The Solution Architect leads one or more workstreams in complex enterprise customer engagements, partnering with key stakeholders to achieve the vision while executing on key deliverables. They serve as hands-on advisors, using strong interpersonal skills, solution and/or technical knowledge, Salesforce product knowledge, industry experience, consulting experience, and knowledge of their client’s business to deliver customer ROI.

Solution Architects are strong presenters and facilitators that are able to co-create the vision and lead the execution with the customer and obtain customer acceptance of the delivered solution. They are capable of driving difficult conversations and removing roadblocks to execute the business strategies. They are proficient at analyzing issues and obstacles to determine root cause, and can identify appropriate corrective action. They communicate with technical and business stakeholders from all levels through C-suite. On a day to day basis, they interact with customer product owners, business process owners and technical resources to understand requirements, analyze information, and design comprehensive solutions. They also show a strong understanding of typical business challenges or common objectives faced by customers within the industry.

Solution Architects are stewards of the Professional Services Methodology and use their networks to ensure that best practices are followed. They engage with Customer Success and Product teams to ensure the solutions are driving the most effective achievement of the value objectives. Solution Architects contribute to thought leadership and best practices by engaging with the cloud-specific practices teams. They will contribute both internally in their Community and externally in the marketplace.

Your Impact

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to the client
  • Identify and lead internal strategic initiatives to grow the consulting practice; serve as an active contributor to the community’s overall knowledge base and expertise
  • Guide customers and colleagues in rationalizing and deploying emerging technologies that drive increased business value
  • Work collaboratively and having very strong communications skills, especially in teaching complex concepts, and creative, prescriptive thinking across various levels of a client organization
  • Identify and proactively manage risk areas and commit to seeing an issue through to complete resolution
  • Manage customer expectations; negotiate solutions to complex problems with both the customer and third-party partners
  • Review and correct project/program direction, approach, and key artifacts to keep programs on track and solutions extendable and maintainable going forward
  • Drive a program vision while advising and articulating program/project strategies to enable technologies including the Salesforce platform

Minimum Requirements

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in enterprise-level projects using both waterfall and agile software development methodologies throughout the whole life cycle with repeated and demonstrable success
  • Extensive experience with configuration and customization on the Salesforce platform
  • Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes
  • Experience leading discovery sessions, defining business requirements, writing user stories and providing detailed system and functional designs

  • Strong analytical skills and a structured approach to software design.
  • Passion for building reliable, well‑tested services.
  • Experience with Agile and iterative development processes.

  • Growth mindset: eager to learn, embrace challenges, persist through setbacks, and learn from feedback and others’ success.
  • Commitment to diversity and inclusion: fostering a culture where everyone can be authentic and heard.
  • Confident and articulate in expressing ideas to diverse audiences.
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability, with the ability to meet deadlines and manage stakeholder expectations.
  • Self‑motivated and collaborative across teams and organizations.

description:

Missão do Cargo

Liderar e coordenar as atividades de tecnologia da informação, assegurando a estabilidade e o desempenho dos sistemas TOTVS voltados à área da saúde, bem como a eficiência da infraestrutura tecnológica e o suporte de excelência aos usuários internos. Responsabilidades

  • Coordenar a área de TI e garantir a estabilidade dos sistemas corporativos;
  • Gerenciar o sistema TOTVS – módulo Saúde, assegurando seu funcionamento, atualizações e integração com demais sistemas;

  • Gerenciar contratos e relacionamento com fornecedores de tecnologia, prezando por qualidade e custo-benefício;
  • Zelar pela segurança da informação, integridade dos dados e continuidade dos serviços de TI;
  • Elaborar relatórios gerenciais e indicadores de performance da área;
  • Apoiar a Diretoria em decisões estratégicas relacionadas a tecnologia e inovação.

Atividades do Dia a Dia

  • Monitorar o desempenho e disponibilidade dos sistemas TOTVS e demais plataformas utilizadas;
  • Supervisionar backups, atualizações, rede interna e infraestrutura de servidores;
  • Atender e direcionar chamados técnicos com foco na satisfação do usuário interno;
  • Manter inventário atualizado de equipamentos e licenças;
  • Promover treinamentos internos sobre uso do sistema e boas práticas de segurança digital;
  • Coordenar equipe de suporte técnico e acompanhar o cumprimento de SLA’s;
  • Realizar interface com áreas administrativas e assistenciais para otimizar fluxos e integrações sistêmicas;
  • Participar de reuniões de alinhamento com gestores e diretoria.

Requisitos Técnicos

  • Experiência comprovada mínima de 3 anos na função de Coordenação ou Supervisão de TI;
  • Domínio em TOTVS – módulo Saúde (implantação, suporte e gestão);
  • Vivência com sistemas de gestão hospitalar ou clínicas;
  • Conhecimento em infraestrutura, redes, servidores e segurança da informação;
  • Capacidade de liderar equipes técnicas e gerir demandas simultâneas;
  • Boa comunicação, proatividade e orientação a resultados.

Atitudes Fundamentais

  • Alfabetização Digital e Fluência Tecnológica;
  • Comunicação Multicanal e Influência Positiva;
  • Gestão de Tempo, Energia e Produtividade Consciente;
  • Inteligência Emocional e Autogestão;
  • Adaptabilidade e Aprendizado Contínuo.

Habilidades Comportamentais

  • Responsabilidade e Comprometimento;
  • Autoconhecimento e Inteligência Emocional;
  • Proatividade e Iniciativa;
  • Flexibilidade e Adaptabilidade;
  • Comunicação Clara e Empática;
  • Foco em Organização, Planejamento e Entrega.

Salário/Benefícios

  • R$ 6.000,00 (CLT – Presencial)
  • Benefícios
  • Vale Transporte;
  • Ticket Refeição;
  • Seguro de Vida em Grupo;
  • Plano Odontológico;
  • Plano de Saúde.

Diferenciais

A saúde e bem-estar norteiam nossas decisões.

Responsibilities

  • Ser o responsável pela governança do processo de Demand Planning dentro do ciclo de S&OP, garantindo alinhamento para evolução do IBP e estratégia corporativa.
  • Liderar a construção do consenso de demanda final que será validado nas reuniões executivas de S&OP.
  • Fortalecer a gestão de portfólio dentro do S&OP, assegurando que cada phase-in e phase-out aconteça de forma fluida, com disciplina e alinhamento estratégico, transformando lançamentos e descontinuações em vantagem competitiva.

  • Conduzir workshops de alinhamento de demanda com áreas envolvidas.
  • Consolidar informações e preparar materiais para o Demand Review Meeting.
  • Manter registro formal de premissas, riscos e decisões tomadas.
  • Suportar auditorias e revisões de governança sobre o processo de S&OP.

title: ALUME Institute Association (NGO) — Co-Founder BizDev Finance
description:
Overview

ALUME Institute Association (NGO) — Co-Founder & Chief Financial and Development Officer (CFDO)

ALUME Institute is a Brazilian non-profit NGO based at Fazenda ALUME in Ilhéus, Bahia. We are dedicated to regenerating land and empowering communities through education, sustainability, health, and culture.

Our farm spans 42 hectares (100 acres) with seven natural springs and is located just 7 km from the Atlantic Ocean on Bahia’s Cacao Coast .

Half of the land remains preserved, while the other half—previously exploited—is being reforested and revitalized through agroforestry and sustainable land management.

Beyond restoration, our mission includes purchasing additional land for preservation , creating tribal co-living communities , and fostering spiritual and social growth .

Our work focuses on:

  • Education and training
  • Ecology, health, and community development
  • Fundraising and financial sustainability for impactful initiatives

Role Overview

We are seeking a Co-Founder & Chief Financial and Development Officer (CFDO) — a strategic leader who will bridge financial strategy and resource development to drive ALUME’s sustainable growth.

This role combines the responsibilities of a CFO (financial structure, governance, compliance) and a Business Development & Fundraising Lead (partnerships, CSR programs, grant strategy).

The ideal candidate will understand NGO business models , funding mechanisms , and how to align financial sustainability with mission impact .

Key Responsibilities – Financial Strategy & Governance (CFO Role)

  • Develop and execute financial strategy, planning, and analysis
  • Oversee budgeting, reporting, cash flow , legal compliance, and audits
  • Manage banking relationships , financial forecasting, and risk control
  • Ensure transparency, accountability , and sustainable financial structure
  • Lead B2B CSR partnership programs with private sector companies
  • Coordinate grant application programs across departments and partners
  • Design and manage fundraising campaigns and sponsorship strategies
  • Explore and secure national and international funding opportunities
  • Build and maintain strategic alliances with institutional partners and donors
  • Develop impact finance models aligned with ALUME’s long-term goals

Commitment

  • 10-12 h/week

This position begins on a volunteer basis during the MVP phase, with a clear pathway toward a salaried executive role once funding is secured. Co-Founder Agreement will be completed together during initial onboarding process, including commitment terms and role description.

Candidate Profile

  • Fluent in Portuguese & English
  • Proven experience in fundraising, grants, or financial management in Brazil (must-have)
  • Strong understanding of NGO business models and funding mechanisms
  • Experience in CSR program development and grant application leadership
  • 3–7 years of relevant finance or development experience preferred
  • CPA or MBA a plus (not mandatory)
  • Skilled in financial planning, reporting, compliance, and donor relations
  • Motivated by social impact, sustainability, and innovation
  • Proactive, collaborative, and comfortable in a startup-NGO environment

What You’ll Gain

  • Co-founder status in a nationally visible NGO
  • Leadership within an interdisciplinary, international community

description:
Selecione a frequência (em dias) de recebimento de alertas:

Localização: RJ-RIO DE JANEIRO, Rio de Janeiro, BR

Se você procura boas oportunidades para sua carreira e deseja atuar em um ambiente dinâmico, desafiador e agradável, é comprometido com os resultados e tem brilho nos olhos, a FQM é o lugar certo para você!

O Grupo FQM é uma empresa da Indústria Farmacêutica que atua desde 1932 no Brasil e faz parte do Grupo multinacional Roemmers, com sede na Argentina, posicionado entre os cinco maiores grupos farmacêuticos da América Latina.

No Brasil, a FQM ocupa a 12ª posição do ranking da Indústria Farmacêutica com faturamento acima de 2 bilhões de reais ao ano. Com um amplo portfólio de medicamentos, suplementos e cosméticos, atua em dois segmentos: medicamentos de prescrição médica (RX) em diversas especialidades terapêuticas, e consumo (OTC) produtos para o autocuidado, isentos de prescrição médica, destinados diretamente ao consumidor final.

A FQM, com mais de 1.500 colaboradores, vem escrevendo sua história por meio de constante aprimoramento do seu portfólio de produtos e processos e da busca incessante pela inovação e excelência para atender às necessidades do mercado farmacêutico no país, promovendo Saúde, Autoestima, Bem-estar e Qualidade de Vida à toda população.

Tenha facilidade de relacionamento com diferentes perfis;

Possua visão orientada a dados;

Tenha habilidade de comunicação oral e escrita;

Tenha bom planejamento do tempo;

Tenha brilho nos olhos e seja protagonista da sua carreira... seu lugar é aqui!

QUAIS SERÃO AS SUAS RESPONSABILIDADES?

  • Realizar estudos de capacidade da fábrica, simulando cenários para propor táticas alinhadas com a estratégia da diretoria. Realizando análise do MFV, detecção de gargalos e criação de projetos de melhoria de ganho de capacidade e eliminação de desperdícios;
  • Calcular o ritmo das famílias produtivas da fábrica, assim como realizar o acompanhamento diário através do Heijunka;
  • Realizar o monitoramento do Sistema de Eficiência Geral do Equipamento (OEE), assim como realizar reuniões no gemba com equipes multidisciplinares, avaliando a eficiência do processo e estimulando melhorias contínuas;
  • Desenvolver ferramentas e dashboards que auxiliem o monitoramento e gestão dos Indicadores da Diretoria de Operações;
  • Atuar como agente de melhoria contínua, identificando gargalos, propondo ações e estratégias de mitigação de problemas de forma a garantir o atingimento dos resultados;
  • Liderar projetos de melhoria contínua (Kaizens) em times multidisciplinares;
  • Conduzir reuniões de performance de processo, prestando assistência na verificação da consistência dos relatórios gerados, compartilhando os resultados atingidos, analisando a avaliação do alcance das metas propostas e as investigações das causas / consequências dos problemas encontrados, a fim de contribuir com a promoção do aprimoramento contínuo dos processos e de utilização de recursos;
  • Disseminar e aplicar os conceitos da filosofia Lean Manufacturing através da ministração de treinamentos e capacitações.
  • Formação em Engenharia de Produção, Engenharia Mecânica, Engenharia Química ou Farmácia.
  • Conhecimento em Lean Manufacturing
  • Pacote Office Avançado
  • Habilidade em comunicação e mediação de conflitos para atingimento de resultados
  • Atuação anterior em melhorias de processos produtivos na Indústria.
  • Noções de Business Intelligence
  • Noções em Power Apps
  • Experiência em Indústria Farmacêutica.

Oferecemos para você:

  • Remuneração compatível com o mercado.
  • Alimentação no Local
  • Vale-alimentação.
  • Assistência médica (plano Bradesco ou Unimed).

title: [Banco de Talentos] Supervisor Bilíngue | Pensi
description:
Estamos em busca de uma pessoa organizada, dinâmica, experiência em coordenar equipes, conhecimento amplo do bilinguismo , paixão por educação.

  • Coordenar o trabalho dos professores, elaborar e revisar material didático, orientar a equipe e ajudar no desenvolvimento da equipe de professores.
  • Apoiar a equipe de supervisores das unidades internacionais.
  • Verificar e garantir o desenvolvimento acadêmico dos alunos;
  • Acompanhar as médias das turmas e discutir com a Coordenação Geral, estratégias para solucionar problemas;
  • Apoiar a Coordenação Geral na organização dos eventos da escola.

- Ensino Superior completo em Letras e Certificações Internacionais

- Desejável Pós em Administração, Supervisão Escolar ou Gestão de Equipes e formação em Pedagogia;

Sobre o Pensi

Presentes no Rio de Janeiro, somos a escola responsável pela missão de formar pessoas que busquem sempre evoluir e que sejam capazes de construir um futuro melhor para si e para os que estão ao seu redor. Unindo excelência à formação socioemocional e cidadã dos alunos, o Pensi está sempre atento às demandas das famílias e do mundo. Em 1998, o Pensi foi fundado por engenheiros do IME e do ITA. Rapidamente, tornou-se conhecido pela sua quantidade de aprovações. Entendendo que isso é a concretização de um trabalho acadêmico que começa nos primeiros anos de vida, a instituição ampliou a atuação para o Ensino Básico, inaugurando a Educação Infantil e o Ensino Fundamental I e II.

Para alcançarmos o nosso objetivo, contamos com um time apaixonado pelo poder transformador da educação e que entende o que é ser escola hoje, se preocupando, em primeiro lugar, com os alunos. Aqui você vai encontrar:

Oferecemos conteúdo de qualidade e ferramentas modernas de ensino desde o início da fase escolar dos alunos. Transformamos o estudo em um hábito.

Ajudamos os alunos a desenvolverem responsabilidades tanto acadêmicas quanto com relação às suas escolhas. Buscamos auxiliá-los na procura por diferentes meios para alcançarem os resultados que desejam, com olhar crítico e com a construção de novos pensamentos e ideias.

Nossas escolas promovem um ambiente colaborativo que estimula e reforça o espírito de coletividade. Encorajamos a troca e o diálogo em nossa comunidade escolar.

Se você sonha em trabalhar transformando vidas e reescrevendo histórias, seu lugar é no Pensi.

We are currently seeking a Senior Medical Director to join our diverse and dynamic team. As a Senior Medical Director at ICON, you will play a pivotal role in leading the medical strategy and oversight of clinical trials, interpreting complex medical data, and contributing to the advancement of inNvative treatments and therapies.

  • Serve as an advocate for the industry supporting precommercial and commercial therapies of pharmaceutical companies.
  • Maintain scientific expertise and knowledge of precommercial and commercial therapies, medical devices, clinical applications, medical treatment guidelines, and research methods.
  • Must stay abreast of relevant medical literature in a self-directed manner
  • Participate in relevant congresses and internal/external meetings
  • Share clinical insights and updates via educational sessions.
  • Responsible for cultivating and maintaining relationships with Health Care Providers (HCPs)and Key Opinion Leader (KOL) networks providing medical and scientific support
  • Leverage scientific and medical discussions to deepen focus on defining clinical treatment pathways
  • Delivers scientific presentations and education to HCP and facilitate of best practice scientific exchange

  • Engage with PIs and site Teams through visits and communications

  • Travel (approximately 70%)

  • Proven track record of successful leadership in clinical development programs.

  • Full available for site visits accross Brazil and Argentina, participation in congresses and sponsor meetings, and global travel as needed.
  • Fluent English and Portuguese; Advanced Spanish.

About Obinex

Obinex is the first fully gamified centralized exchange (CEX), where finance meets game mechanics and NFT-powered experiences. We’re building the platform that will redefine how millions of users interact with trading, staking, and digital economies.

Our MVP is in development, and we’re assembling a global founding team. Now we’re looking for a Senior Rust Engineer to architect, scale, and secure the high-performance systems powering Obinex.

The role

We’re seeking a Senior Product Manager with 8+ years of experience with deep hands‑on experience building FinTech or Web3 products from 0→1. You’ll own the product structure of Obinex, from roadmap definition to detailed documentation, and ensure that every deliverable meets the quality required by both engineers and regulators.

You’ll:

  • Design and own the Product Roadmap, aligning it with business milestones, engineering capacity, and regulatory timelines.
  • Define and document User Stories, User Flows, and User Personas.
  • Create low-fidelity wireframes to communicate product intent and validate concepts.
  • Build and maintain the MVP backlog, prioritizing based on impact and dependencies.
  • Define acceptance criteria and “Definition of Done” for all product features.
  • Collaborate closely with Design, Engineering, Legal, and Compliance to ensure alignment across product development.
  • Provide clear, regulator-ready documentation to support license applications and audits.

What you will bring?

  • 8+ years of experience as a Product Manager.
  • Proven record of shipping fintech or Web3 products from conception to launch.
  • Strong experience designing product roadmaps, user flows, and MVP backlogs.
  • Ability to write technical documentation for engineering and regulatory review (Confluence/Jira).
  • Familiarity with exchange, trading, or staking platforms.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills — able to align technical and business teams.
  • Attention to detail, process discipline, and high standards of execution.

Nice to have

  • Experience in compliance-driven environments (KYC/AML, custody, or regulated fintech).
  • Previous exposure to product audits, regulators, or licensing processes.
  • Experience with Figma, Miro, and roadmap tools (Productboard, Aha!, Jira Advanced Roadmaps).
  • Knowledge of blockchain or crypto market mechanics.

What will you get?

  • Equity from day one in a global fintech startup.
  • Base salary starting once our $5M fundraising round closes (currently in progress).
  • A role with massive ownership: you’ll design the roadmap and documentation that define the first gamified CEX.
  • Direct exposure to regulatory‑grade challenges in fintech + Web3.
  • Real opportunity to grow into Head of Product within 18–24 months.
  • Global, remote‑first culture, obsessed with execution and innovation.

If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we would love to meet you!

As a Java FullStack Architect/Tech Lead , you’ll drive the design and development of scalable low/no-code solutions, enabling safe and efficient developer forking flows. You’ll lead a skilled team, provide technical direction, and collaborate across functions to turn complex business needs into high-quality, maintainable systems. This role offers ownership, innovation, and the chance to shape impactful products in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment.

Must have

  • 8+ years of professional software development experience, with deep expertise in Java and Spring;

  • Proven ability to deliver high-quality, scalable, and maintainable solutions in a fast-paced environment with clear delivery goals;

title: Chief of Staff – Founder’s Office (Remote)
description:
Overview


Chief of Staff – Founder’s Office (Remote) at The Flex. The role is the Founder & CEO’s strategic right hand — a trusted partner, operator, and execution force. This is a company-building position blending strategy, leadership, and action.


About The Flex


fast, seamless, and borderless. Our proprietary Property Management System (PMS) is redefining how people live and landlords operate — removing friction, reducing fees, and unlocking global mobility. We’re assembling a small, elite team of A-Players who thrive under pressure, move fast, and execute with precision. If you want to build a global business from the ground up alongside a visionary founder, this is your opportunity.


The Role


As Chief of Staff, you’ll be the Founder & CEO’s strategic right hand — a trusted partner, operator, and execution force. This isn’t a support role. It’s a company-building position that blends strategy, leadership, and action. You’ll help shape priorities, turn ideas into execution, and ensure the entire organization moves in sync as The Flex scales globally. You’ll gain exposure to every part of the business — operations, product, technology, finance, talent, and expansion — playing a pivotal role in the next phase of growth.


Key Responsibilities



  • Strategic Execution – Drive high-impact initiatives across product, operations, and expansion; translate vision into measurable outcomes.

  • Organizational Alignment – Turn strategic goals into actionable plans; ensure every team is focused on what truly matters.

  • Hiring & Talent – Partner with leadership to identify, recruit, and onboard top talent across all functions.

  • Operational Leadership – Step into critical areas to solve problems, streamline execution, and keep projects on track.

  • Global Expansion – Lead research, planning, and operational setup for new market launches.

  • Process Optimization – Build scalable systems and workflows to enhance speed, clarity, and accountability.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration – Act as the connective tissue between teams — ensuring communication, momentum, and alignment.

  • Founder Leverage – Serve as a trusted advisor to the CEO — preparing briefs, managing priorities, and driving follow-through on key decisions.


What You Bring



  • Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or advanced degree is a plus.

  • Experience in startups, consulting, investment banking, or real estate.

  • Exceptional analytical, strategic, and communication skills.

  • Proven ability to turn ambiguity into structure and action.

  • High adaptability and comfort in fast-paced, high-growth environments.

  • A bias for execution, relentless ownership, and resilience under pressure.


Why Join The Flex



  • High-impact partnership. Work directly with the Founder/CEO on mission-critical projects.

  • Unparalleled exposure. Influence company strategy, growth, and operations from day one.

  • Career acceleration. Launchpad to an executive role or future venture of your own.

  • Freedom & flexibility. Remote-first, outcome-driven culture.

  • Competitive rewards. Compensation + performance-based incentives tied to impact.


Do Not Apply If



  • You want a predictable 9–5 routine.

  • You prefer process over progress.

  • You’re uncomfortable with accountability or speed.

  • You’re not committed to becoming elite in your craft.


About The Flex (cont.)


We’re not building another property company. We’re building a global ecosystem for flexible living — powered by technology, automation, and ambition. If you want to work side-by-side with a founder obsessed with excellence and help shape a company that’s redefining how the world lives and moves — apply now.

  • Gestão da Folha de Pagamento: supervisionar todo o ciclo (lançamento, conferência, fechamento e transmissão) de forma precisa e dentro dos prazos legais. Gerenciar os KPIs da área e contribuir para melhoria continua dos dados.
  • Encargos e Obrigações Legais: assegurar o cumprimento das obrigações acessórias (e-Social periódicos, FGTS, INSS, IRRF, Reoneração de folha e demais eventos associados ao envio das declarações).
  • Gestão de dados: garantir confiabilidade dos dados gerados na área para contribuir para fechamento de resultados da companhia.
  • Administração de Benefícios: coordenar concessão e controle de benefícios (VT, VR, planos de saúde, plano odontol., entre outros oferecidos pela companhia).
  • Gestão de Ponto e Frequência: acompanhar controle de jornada, banco de horas, horas extras e ausências.
  • Admissões e Desligamentos: supervisionar processos de entrada e saída de colaboradores, garantindo conformidade documental e cálculos de rescisão.
  • Atualização Legal e Fiscal: manter-se atualizada sobre mudanças na legislação trabalhista, previdenciária e sindical, avaliando impactos e propondo adequações e atualizações continua do time.
  • Relacionamento Sindical: quando necessário, conduzir negociações, acordos e tratativas com sindicatos e entidades de classe, garantir a conformidade sindical na companhia.
  • Auditorias e Compliance: apoiar auditorias internas e externas, assegurando a rastreabilidade das informações e aderência a políticas internas.
  • Gestão de Equipe: liderar, desenvolver e orientar a equipe de DP, promovendo um ambiente colaborativo e de aprendizado contínuo.
  • Integração com RH e Financeiro: alinhar dados e processos para garantir coerência entre remuneração, orçamento e políticas de pessoas.

Requisitos

title: Financial Applications Director
description:
Overview

Conservation International protects nature for the benefit of humanity. Through science, policy, fieldwork, and finance, we spotlight and secure the most important places in nature for the climate, biodiversity, and for people. With offices in 30 countries and projects in more than 100 countries, Conservation International partners with governments, companies, civil society, Indigenous peoples, and local communities to help people and nature thrive together.

Position Summary

This position is based in Arlington-VA (hybrid), Bogota-Colombia (hybrid) or Brazil (fully remote). This position is responsible for the administration of CI’s financial accounting systems: Unit4 Business World and Concur. The Financial Applications Director ensures optimal use of these systems and their related applications and plays a leading role in the integration of these systems with other CI databases relating to financial data and processes. This role also provides training to users, maintains security, and troubleshoots application issues for both US and field-based staff.

Responsibilities

  • Systems Support
  • Responsible for all aspects of end-user support for financial systems, including:
    • Hands-on resolution of tickets, including documentation in the ticketing system and communication with affected staff and IT stakeholders.
    • Communication with software vendors for issues that cannot be resolved internally.
    • Management of other support staff and coordination with business process owners and other team members as needed to resolve tickets.
    • Oversee creation, maintenance, and termination of user accounts in financial systems. Conduct periodic security audits as required.
    • Create and manage complex workflow processes for appropriate systems, including troubleshooting and maintenance.
    • Design special-purpose reports and processes utilizing SQL Server, Business World reporting tools, or other tools as required for audits or other management uses. This includes Business World AG16’s (SQL-based customizations). Manage design, test, and maintain custom reports and forms in Business World using ARC (Agresso Report Creator). This includes complex reports such as the check and the purchase order form.
    • Create and maintain security roles for both menu and reporting (data) access.
  • System Maintenance, Enhancements, and Vendor Management
  • Ensure financial systems are up to date and used to maximum effect:
  • Lead or participate in identifying system improvements, modifications, and enhancements that will streamline processes, increase efficiency, and provide needed functionality.
  • Develop and maintain interfaces to other systems as needed.
  • Serve as the Business World applications ‘go-to’ person by researching software functionality, staying current on technology changes, and advising on best practices.
  • Test patches to ensure that they resolve issues as intended. Work with systems software vendors and CI’s IT department to facilitate the migration of patches to production that have passed testing. Create/maintain system configuration as needed to ensure optimal processing.
  • Maintain and manage relationships with financial systems, software, and service vendors to ensure strong working relationships, maximized levels of support, and efficient use of CI’s resources.
  • Documentation and Training
  • Develop and maintain financial systems SharePoint resource site(s) with relevant help materials for end users.
  • Draft and update financial systems user and administrative procedures as needed.
  • Conduct training for end users as required.
  • Project Management/Change Management
  • Manage financial systems team meetings. Coordinate with business process owners, super users, and other team members as needed to ensure good communication on all financial system-related issues.
  • Manage the change management system to ensure all changes to production financial systems are properly documented, approved, tested, and implemented.

Other duties as assigned by the supervisor.

Working Conditions

  • Normal office environment.
  • Guidance on flexible work arrangements will be shared during the interview process.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field.
  • 7 or more years of related experience.
  • 2 or more years of supervisory experience.
  • Strong knowledge of Financial Applications, including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Contract Accounting, Operating Budget, Project Management, and Procurement modules.
  • Solid working knowledge of database architecture and management
  • SQL Server and Visual Basic experience
  • Experience with ERP reporting tools
  • Project management skills.
  • Ability to adapt and work effectively with functional teams across the organization.
  • Understanding of accounting processes and standards.
  • Experience in training on software applications.
  • Preferred
  • Administrator experience using Unit4 Business World
  • Fluency in Spanish, Portuguese, Indonesian, and/or French

To apply for this position please submit a resume and cover letter.

title: SELECIONADOR - HOSPITAL MUNICIPAL PEDRO II
description:
Sobre o Hospital

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Realizar processos de Recrutamento e Seleção para profissionais de todas as categorias, obedecendo aos métodos adotados pela Instituição.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Superior completo em Gestão de RH ou Superior cursando a partir do 5° semestre em Psicologia;
  • Conhecimento em entrevista por competências;
  • Experiência mínima de 06 meses em atuação na área de Recrutamento e Seleção.

Santa Cruz, RJ

Carga horária: 40 horas semanais.

title: Director, Infrastructure (Software Delivery & Enablement)
description:
Overview

GitLab is an open-core software company that develops the most comprehensive AI-powered DevSecOps Platform, used by more than 100,000 organizations. Our mission is to enable everyone to contribute to and co-create the software that powers our world. When everyone can contribute, consumers become contributors, significantly accelerating human progress. Our platform unites teams and organizations, breaking down barriers and redefining whats possible in software development. Thanks to products like Duo Enterprise and Duo Agent Platform, customers get AI benefits at every stage of the SDLC.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

Role overview

As Director, Infrastructure you will lead the modernization of GitLabs software delivery and developer experience teams, overseeing a large organization of around 60 to 80 people. You will drive the transformation of our software development lifecycle, from how developers build and test code to how customers receive and deploy GitLab, ensuring a seamless and scalable delivery across both SaaS and self-managed environments. This role offers a unique opportunity to shape the future of our platform by consolidating delivery methods, introducing AI-driven efficiencies, and advancing the quality of GitLab. Reporting directly to our VP of Platforms, your impact in the first year will include expanding and integrating teams, modernizing engineering practices, and delivering a streamlined, high-quality software experience for our global customer base.

What youll do

  • Lead the consolidation and modernization of software delivery processes across both SaaS and self-managed GitLab products, ensuring a seamless developer-to-customer lifecycle.
  • Drive the expansion and integration of delivery teams, managing an existing organization of 60+ engineers and senior leaders to meet evolving business needs.
  • Collaborate closely with product leadership and peer directors to align delivery and quality strategies with product goals and customer requirements.
  • Own the strategy for scalable software development and deployments such as, designing new developer tooling, driving API first culture, and transitioning customers to recommended installation methods such as Kubernetes-based platforms.
  • Foster cross-functional partnerships with infrastructure and development engineering teams to enhance operational stability and software reliability.
  • Measure and improve key delivery metrics to ensure high-quality, timely releases that meet customer expectations.
  • Mentor and develop senior managers and principal engineers, building a strong leadership bench to support ongoing growth and innovation.

What youll bring

  • Experience leading and managing large teams, with the ability to oversee an organization of 60 or more people, including senior managers and principal engineers.
  • Proven expertise in software delivery across both SaaS and self-managed environments, with a clear understanding of the nuances between these deployment models.
  • Demonstrated success in driving transformation initiatives, particularly evolving traditional quality engineering practices into modern developer experience and test platform approaches.
  • Strong knowledge of the full software development lifecycle, from developer workflows through to customer delivery and operational stability.
  • Background in platform engineering and infrastructure, with operational experience that informs decisions about software delivery and platform stability.
  • Ability to integrate developer experience tools with software delivery processes to improve quality and efficiency.
  • Effective collaboration skills to work cross-functionally with product leadership, peers, and direct reports in a globally distributed, asynchronous environment.
  • Openness to diverse professional backgrounds and transferable skills, valuing a broad perspective on software delivery and platform operations.

About the team

The team is responsible for the end-to-end software delivery lifecycle at GitLab, encompassing both developer experience and the delivery of the product to customers in SaaS and self-managed environments. The team operates across multiple regions with a focus on asynchronous collaboration to ensure alignment and efficiency. Their mission is to modernize and transform GitLabs development and delivery processes, ensuring the quality and scalability of what we deliver to our customers. Existing GitLab Delivery and Developer Experience teams are ready to embark on the next stage of their lifecycle, focusing on consolidating diverse delivery methods into streamlined, customer-friendly installation options while continuously improving developer tools and operational stability.

Compensation and benefits

The base salary range for this roles listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the roles base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our benefits and equity. Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary.

United States Salary Range $194,800 — $420,000 USD

  • Flexible Paid Time Off
  • Team Member Resource Groups
  • Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Growth and Development Fund
  • Parental leave
  • Home office support

title: Engenheiro(a) de Dados - Pleno/Senior
description:
Resumo do cargo

O(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados deve ser capaz de criar, expandir e otimizar a arquitetura de pipelines de dados, bem como desenvolver e manter fluxos de dados de diversas áreas de nossos clientes. Este(a) profissional deve estar familiarizado(a) com conceitos e estratégias de DataOps, bem como execução de projetos gerenciados em modelo Ágil. O conhecimento de tecnologias de big data é imprescindível para esse cargo. É importante que se relacione bem com diferentes equipes - tecnologia e área de negócio principalmente - e que possa apontar oportunidades de melhoria na forma de estruturação dos dados para atingir o objetivo de análise do cliente.

Responsabilidades

  • Criar e realizar manutenção e melhoria de fluxos e dados (ETL e ELT) em casos de alta complexidade
  • Transformar dados
  • Realizar desenvolvimento, testagem, homologação, implantação, correção, entrega e automatização de testes em rotinas e processos complexos
  • Utilizar de ambientes Hadoop, Spark e estruturas Cloud (Azure, AWS e GCP) para construção e execução dos pipelines de dados
  • Participar de reuniões com equipe e clientes e das cerimônias propostas pela gestão de projetos ágeis
  • Interagir com áreas de negócio complexas para validação das entregas e realização de possíveis ajustes para o acompanhamento de Engenheiro(a) de Dados intermediários(as)
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhorias em processos, bem como desenhar e implementar as soluções propostas como: automação de processos manuais, otimização de data delivery, melhoria de arquitetura para aumento de desempenho e outras
  • Criar e melhorar continuamente a arquitetura de pipelines de dados
  • Combinar diversas bases de dados grandes e complexas para endereçar requisitos funcionais e não funcionais do negócio

Requisitos

  • Domínio em Databricks
  • Experiência sólida com linguagem SQL e Python
  • Conhecimento do stack de dados Azure/AWS/GCP e técnicas de DataOps
  • Experiência com construção de fluxos de dados utilizando ferramentas de big data
  • Visão de foco no cliente e habilidade para comunicar ideias de forma clara e concisa, assim como em resolução de problemas

Sobre nós

A Five Acts valoriza a diversidade, a equidade e a inclusão. Acreditamos que a diversidade é uma força impulsionadora da inovação e do crescimento. Nossas oportunidades são abertas para todas as pessoas.

O que oferecemos

  • Seguro de Vida em grupo

  • Incentivo a certificações e cursos
  • Convênio para cursos de pós-graduação e MBA (Esalq/USP)

  • Parceria com academias e apps de bem-estar (Wellhub)

PRIO Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Join to apply for the Técnico de Inspeção (NR-13) SPIE role at PRIO

Somos a PRIO, a maior companhia independente de óleo e gás do Brasil. Buscamos continuamente por otimização de processos operacionais e de soluções inovadoras que visem diminuir os custos. Aqui todo trabalho é multidisciplinar e cada desafio é único!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Realizar inspeções visuais e técnicas em equipamentos estáticos, avaliando taxas de deterioração, corrosão e danos estruturais.
  • Aplicar técnicas de ensaio não destrutivo (END), como Medição de Espessura, Líquido Penetrante, Partícula Magnética e Inspeção de Solda.
  • Elaborar e executar planos de inspeção conforme periodicidade e critérios definidos pela NR-13.
  • Registrar e monitorar os resultados das inspeções em sistemas como CMMS, garantindo rastreabilidade e conformidade documental.
  • Emitir relatórios técnicos e recomendações de manutenção preventiva e corretiva.
  • Atuar em conformidade com os padrões de segurança, meio ambiente e qualidade da empresa e da legislação vigente.
  • Participar de análises de falhas e investigações técnicas relacionadas à integridade dos equipamentos.
  • Assegurar que todos os instrumentos de inspeção estejam calibrados e em conformidade com os padrões técnicos.
  • Colaborar com equipes de manutenção, operação e engenharia para garantir a confiabilidade dos ativos.

Requisitos e qualificações

Formação acadêmica

  • Formação técnica em Mecânica, Metalurgia ou áreas correlatas.

Experiência prévia desejada

  • Experiência prévia atuando em unidade offshore com certificação SPIE;
  • Conhecimento na inspeção de equipamentos de caldeiras, vasos de pressão, sistemas relacionados e acessórios;
  • Conhecimento do sistema SGI.

Qualificações/certificações necessárias (Offshore)

  • Ter qualificação de Líquido Penetrante e Medição de Espessura ABENDI válidas;
  • Formação de Auditores Internos de SPIE (Certificação pelo IBP);
  • Qualificação N1 de Solda, será um diferencial;
  • Qualificação de IRATA , será um diferencial.

Informações adicionais

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura. Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você para aprofundar suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental. Também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas. Dicas: esteja pronto para apresentar experiências alinhadas aos valores da PRIO com contexto, responsabilidade, ações e resultados. Em etapas seguintes, poderá ocorrer um case ou entrevista com o gestor, para conhecer os desafios técnicos da vaga. Finalistas conversarão com o diretor da área para a escolha final.

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

  • Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;
  • Atualize-se sobre as notícias da companhia, seja pela imprensa ou pelo site de relações com investidores;
  • Acesse nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre trabalhar na PRIO;
  • Pense na sua história e principais realizações, estruturando resultados para apresentar durante a entrevista.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

title: Director of Support Engineering
description:
About The Role

As a Director of Support Engineering, you will play a crucial role in ensuring that our clients receive the highest level of technical support and service. We are looking for a dynamic leader who is passionate about customer satisfaction and has a strong technical background. If you, we want to hear from you.

This role is a good fit for someone who thrives in a fast‑paced, innovative environment and has a proven track record of managing successful technical support teams.

Responsibilities

  • Building, mentoring, and inspiring a high‑performing distributed team of Support Engineers, fostering a culture of excellence, accountability, and AI‑driven innovation
  • Leading AI‑first transformations of support workflows and decision‑making processes, embedding intelligent systems into daily operations to enhance speed, accuracy, and quality
  • Owning and optimizing core support processes including ticket management, incident response and escalation procedures
  • Establishing and monitoring performance metrics across the team ensuring high performance and efficient operations
  • Ensuring compliance with service level agreements and maintaining high levels of customer retention
  • Identifying training and development needs for the technical support team and providing resources and support for their professional growth
  • Designing and implementing enterprise‑grade support processes and service delivery models
  • Acting as a senior escalation leader during critical incidents, providing clear, calm, and strategic guidance to both internal teams and customer executives
  • Fostering a positive and collaborative work culture within the technical support team, promoting teamwork and employee engagement
  • Championing cross‑functional alignment by working closely with Customer Success, Product, Engineering, and Professional Services to drive shared goals and frictionless customer experiences
  • Driving strategic initiatives in partnership with senior leadership to evolve the vision, strategy, and operating model of the Technical Support function in an AI‑first world

About the Team

We’re a tight‑knit team of tech pros who love tackling tough problems. No challenge is too big—we dig deep to find the right answers every time. We’ve got each other’s backs and are always looking for ways to grow, improve, and deliver better results together. Our culture is all about learning, growing, and making a meaningful impact. We don’t stop until we’ve found the best solution, and we’re always ready to jump in and support one another. By working as a team, we consistently deliver high‑quality results—and we keep raising the bar. Even when things get hectic, we stay calm, focused, and solutions‑driven. Clear communication is one of our core strengths, ensuring both our partners and teammates get the support they need. We’re committed to doing the job right, no matter what, and we pride ourselves on staying close to our partners to make sure they have exactly what they need to succeed.

What You’ll Do

Within 3 months, you will:

  • Learn company products, services, and customer base in depth
  • Understand support tools, systems, workflows, and escalation processes
  • Review existing KPIs
  • Build Team & Stakeholder Relationships
  • Identify quick wins in ticket handling, response times, or escalation paths
  • Meet with direct reports and cross‑functional leaders (Engineering, Product, Sales, Customer Success)

Within 6 months, you will:

  • Establish clear roles, responsibilities, and expectations
  • Introduce a quality control motion to ensure fixes are properly tested
  • Build robust onboarding program for new hires allowing them to be effective quickly and predictably
  • Improve reporting and analytics dashboards for visibility into KPIs
  • Begin designing long‑term support strategies (e.g., self‑service improvements, tiered support models)

Within 9 months, you will:

  • Build a culture of accountability, customer empathy, and continuous improvement
  • Delight cross‑functional partners and stakeholders: Customer Success, Engineering, Solutions Consulting
  • Recognize and reward top performers
  • Launch a roadmap for scaling support operations (e.g., automation, AI chatbots, advanced knowledge management)

What You’ll Bring

  • 5+ years of experience in technical support for enterprise software or SaaS platforms, with a strong emphasis on driving innovation through automation and AI
  • 3+ years in leadership roles, with a proven ability to build and scale high‑impact support organizations in fast‑paced, AI‑forward environments
  • Proven ability to lead and develop organizations of 20+ employees including management of managers
  • Demonstrated success building globally distributed, high‑performing teams, with a focus on asynchronous collaboration, operational resilience, and intelligent tooling
  • Exceptional communication skills, capable of distilling complex technical topics for both executive‑level and technical audiences across varied customer profiles
  • Deep expertise in enterprise SaaS platforms cloud architectures and complex B2B software solutions
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and execute enterprise‑level strategies with measurable business impact

What’s In It For You

  • Remote Flexibility: Enjoy the freedom of remote work from anywhere, balancing life and career seamlessly.
  • Unforgettable Off‑Sites: Twice a year, bond with colleagues in exciting destinations, fostering teamwork and fresh ideas.
  • Paid Time Off and National Holidays: Enjoy 20 PTO days yearly and the National Holidays for relaxation and rejuvenation.
  • Stock Options: Joining us means having a stake in our success, so you’ll receive stock options as part of your compensation package.
  • Home Office Setup: Create your ideal workspace with a dedicated budget for home office essentials.
  • Work Trip Budget: Grow personally and professionally with a budget for work‑related trips and co‑working.

About Us

Clutch is a revolutionary vertical SaaS company, proudly backed by Andreessen Horowitz (A16z), aimed at revolutionizing the way Credit Unions engage and change the lives of their members. As a champion of financial well‑being, we address the urgent need for affordable lending solutions in an era where the average American grapples with over $155,000 in household debt. Unlike traditional financial institutions, Clutch develops software to turn Credit Unions into FinTech lenders and leverage their balance sheets to responsibly lend to over 130M Americans. Our mission extends beyond mere financial transactions; we strive to fundamentally enhance the way credit unions interact with their members. By integrating cutting‑edge technologies and user‑centric designs, we help credit unions provide seamless digital experiences that are on par with leading tech companies. This approach not only preserves but revitalizes the longstanding tradition of community and member‑focused service inherent to credit unions.

Please note: This position is offered on a contractor basis. Applicants must have the necessary documentation and authorization to work in the country where the job is located. Clutch cannot provide sponsorship or assist with obtaining work permits for this role.

A Note About AI At Clutch: We love AI. We use it often and encourage our team to creatively and effectively leverage AI tools in their work. If you join Clutch, we hope you’ll bring the same enthusiasm for exploring how AI can amplify impact, productivity, and innovation. That said, during the interview process, we want to hear your thoughts. Please approach interviews without the use of AI tools—our goal is to get to know how you think, solve problems, and communicate. Once you're in the seat, bring on the prompts!

title: Surveyor I
description:
Overview

The Surveyor I is an entry or junior-level position for new graduates and/or those with less than five (5) years of experience in an applicable industry. The Surveyor I, under a direct supervisor, performs work involving conventional surveying practices. The primary function is to develop the ability to effectively examine and report on vessels and other marine structures during and after construction relative to compliance with the applicable requirements for maintaining the vessel in Classification with ABS and meeting associated statutory and special service requirements related to Safety of Life at Sea, Loadline, Tonnage, Cargo Gear and Pollution Prevention Certification.

What You Will Do (with the assistance and guidance of an experienced ABS Surveyor)

  • Acts as a professional specialist for the organization in the application of related rules, regulations, requirements, concepts, principles, and processes.
  • Performs routine surveys on classed vessels, platforms, or other marine structures and at manufacturers for classification and compliance with statutory requirements.
  • Prepares technically accurate and timely reports of inspections and surveys performed.
  • Engages in contact with clients to resolve problems within areas of expertise.
  • Maintains survey files in an orderly and up-to-date manner in the area of responsibility.
  • Develops the skills necessary for the administration of office procedures and monitoring of business performance at an assigned port.
  • Through broader and more technically challenging work assignments, the individual must develop a thorough understanding of field operations, policies, methods, and procedures.

What You Will Need

Education and Experience

  • Qualifications from a tertiary institution within a relevant field of engineering or physical science (minimum two (2) years program); or
  • Qualifications from a marine or nautical institution and relevant seagoing experience as a certificated ship officer, and
  • Proficiency in the English language commensurate with the scope of statutory certification and services and, before assignment, with their future work.
  • Appropriate certification and/or licenses in areas of specialization may be required.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Ability to develop a working knowledge of ABS Rules, Guides, statutory regulations, and related instructions, as well as the ABS Employee Safety Policy.
  • Ability to read engineering plans and have a basic understanding of shipbuilding practices and vessel operations.
  • Ability to perform surveys in the prescribed format.
  • Knowledge of computer programs or software packages related to job responsibilities.
  • Knowledge of related technical interfaces required for group project work.
  • Knowledge of ships' engineering systems and machinery.
  • Ability to communicate, orally and in writing, pertinent information relative to assigned area of technical expertise.
  • Ability to analyze problems and propose solutions.
  • Responsiveness to customers and the ability to work well with others.
  • Ability to become familiar with the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management Systems.

Physical Requirements

  • Where allowed by local laws, a pre-employment physical examination is mandatory.
  • The role of surveyor/auditor requires sufficient physical strength, stamina, agility, and both visual and auditory acuity to perform the listed duties effectively.
  • The ability to climb vertical ladders up to nine meters and navigate steep steps is essential.
  • Shall be capable of working at heights on various staging and lifting equipment.
  • Shall be able to maneuver in tight spaces and work inside confined areas for extended periods, including kneeling and crawling.
  • The role may involve exposure to industrial environments, potential injury risks, extreme weather conditions, and demanding physical activities.
  • Shall be able to lift at least 25 lbs. / 11.34 kgs.
  • The use of small tools and the wearing of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), in accordance with ABS safety procedures, may be required.
  • Where allowed by local laws, the surveyor will be required to successfully complete an annual physical that will recertify the individual can perform the physical actions required.

Reporting Relationships

Will report to the Principal, Senior, or Surveyor-in-Charge of the assigned port. This position does not have any direct reports.

About Us

We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times.

ABS is a global leader in marine and offshore classification and other innovative safety, quality, and environmental services. We’re at the forefront of supporting the global energy transition at sea, the application of remote and autonomous marine systems, cutting-edge technical solutions, and many more exciting advancements. Our commitment to safety, reliability, and efficiency is ever-present, guiding our clients to safer and more efficient operations.

Equal Opportunity

ABS Bureau is committed to the equal employment opportunity of its employees and prohibits discrimination against any employee or qualified applicant based on race, color, creed, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, citizenship status or veteran status, or other non-work-related characteristics that may be protected under the law of the Federal Government or specific state employment laws.

Notice

ABS and Affiliated Companies (ABS) will not pay a fee to any third-party agency without a valid ABS Master Service Agreement (MSA) authorized and signed by Human Resources. Any resume, CV, application, or other forms of candidate submission provided to any employee of ABS without a valid MSA on file will be considered property of ABS, and no fee will be paid.

Other

This job description is not intended, and should not be construed, to be an all-inclusive list of responsibilities, skills, efforts or working conditions associated with the job of the incumbent. It is intended to be an accurate reflection of the principal job elements essential for making a fair decision regarding the pay structure of the job. #ogjs

description:

Período de inscrição até: 22/10/2025

ATENÇÃO: É imprescindível anexar o currículo atualizado no ato da candidatura.

A Mosaic Company valoriza a diversidade, a inclusão e o desenvolvimento contínuo. Igualdade e oportunidades a todos fazem parte do dia a dia dos nossos profissionais, que encontrarão aqui a trilha ideal para desenvolver suas carreiras. Nos orgulhamos de ter o respeito como um valor. E acreditamos que a inovação acontece quando temos um ambiente cercado de diferenças em todos seus aspectos, como idade, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade, cor, deficiência ou religião.

Quais serão suas responsabilidades?

  • Executar a estratégia de vendas no curto e médio prazo.
  • Interagir com os principais stakeholders (externos e internos), construir um relacionamento de confiança com os níveis de liderança da organização para conseguir agir como um influenciador.
  • Fornecer ao Diretor Regional informações de sua região e trabalhar muito próximo aos principais clientes para alavancar o volume de vendas e as margens.
  • Participar em conjunto com a equipe nas principais negociações, quando necessário.
  • Gestão do desenvolvimento de pessoas é uma prioridade para esta posição.

O que procuramos?

  • Superior Completo em Agronomia ou Administração.
  • Desejável pós graduação.
  • Inglês Avançado
  • Experiência com gestão de pessoas.
  • Conhecimento do mercado do arco norte (MATOPIPA)
  • Atuação prévia com orçamento de volumes da gerência, através de análise do potencial e perspectivas de mercado, garantindo a execução através do time de vendas.
  • Experiência na gestão comercial - negociação e vendas: geração de demanda e condução de trabalhos de campo (demoplots, dia de campo, palestras e treinamentos).
  • Conhecimento sólido do mercado de biológicos.
  • Conhecimento profundo em fertilidade de solo, fertilizantes solúveis e nutrição de plantas.
  • Conhecimento avançado do cenário macroeconômico e de suas influências no agronegócio.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens constantes. Devido ao alto volume de viagens, deve ter fácil acesso a aeroportos.

Qual será seu horário de trabalho?

Administrativo

Qual será seu modelo de trabalho?

Home office

O que oferecemos?

  • Convênio Médico;
  • Convênio Odontológico;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Remuneração Variável;
  • Previdência Privada;
  • Auxílio Academia;
  • Vale Refeição;
  • Programa de Assistência ao Empregado (Apoiar);
  • Programa Bem Estar (Wellness);
  • Licença Maternidade e Paternidade Estendida;
  • Auxílio Material Escolar;
  • Benefício para filhos de 5 a 13 anos incompletos

Sobre nós

Com a missão de ajudar o mundo a produzir os alimentos de que precisa, a Mosaic atua da mina ao campo. A empresa entrega cerca de 27,2 milhões de toneladas de fertilizantes ao ano para 40 países, sendo uma das maiores produtoras globais de fosfatados e potássio combinados.

title: [Rio de Janeiro] Gerente Paula Cotrim | Vendas - Seguros de Vida e Previdência (Autônomo - Atua[...]
description:
Overview

(Rio de Janeiro) Gerente Paula Cotrim | Vendas - Seguros de Vida e Previdência (Autônomo - Atuação Presencial)

Descrição da vaga: Quer redirecionar sua carreira profissional, aprender uma nova profissão e iniciar seu próprio negócio? Venha atuar como Corretor de Vida e Previdência na MAG Seguros! Você ingressará no nosso Programa para Formação de Novos Corretores, onde aprenderá tudo sobre Seguro de Vida e Previdência. Realizará o curso preparatório para o exame de Habilitação Técnico Profissional e, ao ser aprovado, terá sua licença para atuar como Corretor de Seguros, começando o seu próprio negócio, com todo o suporte e expertise da MAG Seguros.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Você atuará como profissional autônomo com as seguintes atribuições:
  • Inicialmente, se dedicará exclusivamente ao curso preparatório da MAG Universidade para obtenção da habilitação técnico profissional junto a Susep;
  • Após a conquista da Habilitação:
  • Identificará potenciais clientes para abordar, utilizando sua Rede de Relacionamento para agendamento de entrevistas de vendas e solicitação de indicações;
  • Fará telemarketing ativo para agendar entrevistas de vendas;
  • Realizará as entrevistas de vendas, identificando as necessidades de proteção financeira do prospect e ofertando as soluções mais adequadas a cada perfil;
  • Gerenciará a sua carteira de clientes com foco na sustentabilidade financeira do seu negócio.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Aptidão para vendas;
  • Amplo círculo social (network/ rede de relacionamento);
  • Perfil ativo nas redes sociais;

Você se diferenciará

  • Experiência como profissional autônomo, liberal ou empreendedor;
  • Experiência com venda consultiva e rotina de vendas externas.

Informações adicionais

  • PESSOAS BEM-SUCEDIDAS NESSA PROFISSÃO: São aguerridas, motivadas, resilientes e persistentes, dedicando à construção do sucesso de seu próprio negócio;
  • Identificam-se com o propósito de despertar nas pessoas o desejo e a necessidade de assegurar o próprio futuro e o das pessoas que amam;
  • Possuem ampla rede de relacionamento, frequentam grupos sociais ligados a esporte, religião, hobbies, culinária, educação, negócios ou qualquer outro tema que permita estar em contato frequente com diferentes pessoas, ampliando o círculo social;
  • Possuem como prioridades o sucesso profissional e os ganhos financeiros, independente de regime de contratação de trabalho;
  • Têm disponibilidade para atuar conforme agenda do cliente, possuindo flexibilidade na rotina de trabalho, para atendimento além dos horários convencionais;
  • Atuam com disciplina no planejamento semanal das atividades de vendas, de acordo com os parâmetros necessários para o atingimento e superação dos objetivos financeiros e pessoais;
  • Dedicam-se ao estudo contínuo em busca de novos conhecimentos, mantendo-se atualizadas profissionalmente.

Já pensou em redirecionar sua carreira ou aprender uma nova profissão? Agora imagine só, poder fazer isso sendo parceiro de uma empresa que, há quase 200 anos, ajuda as pessoas a planejar um futuro financeiro mais tranquilo. Aqui na MAG, nossos corretores parceiros são chamados de Especialistas em Proteção Financeira. E se você tem tino comercial, gosta de se relacionar com pessoas, tem perfil empreendedor e deseja trabalhar com o forte propósito de prover soluções financeiras individuais nos diversos momentos de vida de todos os brasileiros, nosso Programa para Formação de Especialistas em Proteção Financeira é a oportunidade ideal para você!

Sabemos bem que um processo de mudança de carreira pode ser algo difícil. Mas, participando de nosso Programa, você terá todo o suporte necessário para ser bem sucedido, desde o treinamento em sala de aula - onde aprenderá mais sobre a empresa, seu portfólio e o processo de vendas – até o acompanhamento em campo, onde realizará - com a supervisão de nossos líderes especialistas - as primeiras entrevistas de vendas.

Conheça as vantagens de se tornar Especialistas em Proteção Financeira parceiro da MAG Seguros

  • Além de toda estrutura de suporte, treinamento e acompanhamento, poderemos apoiá-lo financeiramente na fase inicial de constituição de seu negócio, mediante o atingimento de critérios mínimos de produtividade.
  • Subsídios de até 70% para adquirir produtos como plano de saúde, de telefonia móvel, seguros de vida, notebook e smartphone, mediante elegibilidade ao nosso Programa de Fidelidade
  • Comissionamento vitalício sobre grande parte das coberturas comercializadas, ou seja, a comissão é do corretor pelo tempo em que o contrato do cliente estiver ativo, permitindo ganhos ilimitados.
  • Atuação presencial, com relacionamento multicanal, que pode ser realizado via unidades de vendas, telefone, WhatsApp, e-mail e chat, além de portal exclusivo para corretores.

Overview

Descrição da vaga. Atualmente a nossa Cultura passa por um processo de transformação e evolução. A nossa história e o nosso jeito de ser são marcados por sonhos grandes que nos trouxeram até aqui e que nos enchem de orgulho! Mas acreditamos que o momento de evoluir é sempre o agora e poder fazer isso junto com a nossa gente é o que torna nossa jornada ainda mais incrível.

Nossa cultura honra o passado e hoje também é norteada por 3 principais valores que nos guiam para sermos uma cia cada vez mais inclusiva, diversa, colaborativa, tecnológica e conectada ao futuro do mundo e da nossa plataforma de negócios: Escuta Ativa, Colaboração e Visão de Longo Prazo, cada um abarcando outras competências que fazem parte do nosso jeito de ser. Nos orgulhamos da nossa capacidade de realização e paixão que nos trouxeram até aqui e para continuarmos a evoluir juntos te convidamos a fazer parte também dessa jornada.

Prazer, somos a Ambev e adoraríamos te ter com a gente. Vamos juntos?!

Responsabilidades

  • Gerenciar os KPI's (Indicadores-Chave de Desempenho) relacionados às operações.
  • Acompanhar e atuar no TME (Tempo Médio de Entrega), percentual de estadias e devoluções junto aos clientes (Atendimento ao Cliente) e transportadoras.
  • Identificar os principais motivos que impactam o Fill Rate e implementar ações para melhorar o nível de serviço prestado aos clientes.
  • Negociar ANS (Acordo Nacional sobre Serviços) com as áreas comercial, logística (Ambev + transportadora) e com os clientes, definindo dias de entrega, janelas de recebimento, paletização mínima (rota e fora da rota), quantidade e perfil dos caminhões.
  • Realizar reuniões mensais com os clientes e KAMs (Key Account Managers) para analisar todos os pontos definidos nas reuniões sobre ANS com a rede, incluindo KPI's sob sua gestão (% estadias, TME, Fill Rate, Devolução).
  • Solucionar problemas não comerciais dos clientes tornando-se o ponto focal logístico para eles.
  • Acompanhar diariamente o status da operação (descarga na rede), informando todas as partes envolvidas no processo (Clientes, GOD Gestão Operacional Direta, KAM).

Se você tem raciocínio lógico rápido para tomada de decisões eficazes e deseja fazer parte de uma equipe dinâmica onde suas ações impactam diretamente nossos clientes, queremos conhecer você!

Senior Pharmacovigilance Associate - Brazil - Remote

ICON plc is a world-leading healthcare intelligence and clinical research organization. We’re proud to foster an inclusive environment driving innovation and excellence, and we welcome you to join us on our mission to shape the future of clinical development.

We are currently seeking a Senior Pharmacovigilance Associate to join our diverse and dynamic team. As a Senior Pharmacovigilance Associate at ICON, you will be instrumental in ensuring the safety and efficacy of pharmaceutical products by managing and overseeing pharmacovigilance activities. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and to maintain the highest standards of patient safety.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Leading the collection, evaluation, and processing of adverse event reports to ensure timely and accurate reporting in accordance with regulatory guidelines and company policies.
  • Conducting thorough data analysis and interpretation of safety data, identifying trends and potential safety signals that require further investigation.
  • Preparing and submitting comprehensive periodic safety update reports (PSURs) and other regulatory documents, ensuring compliance with international regulations.
  • Collaborating with medical and clinical teams to assess the clinical relevance of reported adverse events and contribute to risk management activities.
  • Overseeing the maintenance and integrity of pharmacovigilance databases, ensuring accurate documentation and compliance with data management standards.
  • Providing training and mentorship to junior team members on pharmacovigilance processes, regulatory requirements, and best practices.
  • Engaging in audits and inspections conducted by regulatory authorities, ensuring readiness and compliance with all relevant pharmacovigilance requirements.
  • Staying informed on evolving regulatory guidelines and industry best practices to continually enhance the pharmacovigilance processes within the organization.

Your Profile

  • Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, pharmacy, nursing, or a related field. An advanced degree is preferred.
  • Extensive experience in pharmacovigilance or drug safety, with a strong understanding of relevant regulations and industry standards.
  • Proven ability to manage the pharmacovigilance process effectively, including adverse event reporting and signal detection.
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills, with the ability to interpret complex data and make informed recommendations.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work collaboratively across cross-functional teams.
  • Proficiency in pharmacovigilance databases and data management systems, as well as Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Commitment to maintaining confidentiality and handling sensitive patient information with discretion.

What ICON can offer you

Our success depends on the quality of our people. That’s why we’ve made it a priority to build a diverse culture that rewards high performance and nurtures talent.

In addition to your competitive salary, ICON offers a range of additional benefits. Our benefits are designed to be competitive within each country and are focused on well‑being and work life balance opportunities for you and your family.

Our benefits examples include:

  • Various annual leave entitlements

  • Life assurance
  • Flexible country‑specific optional benefits, including childcare vouchers, bike purchase schemes, discounted gym memberships, subsidized travel passes, health assessments, among others.

Data QA is an important function within Zyte. The Data QA team works to ensure that the quality and usability of the data scraped by our web scrapers meets and exceeds the expectations of our enterprise clients.

Are you passionate about data and data quality and integrity? Do you enjoy using Python and AI to analyze and manipulate data, detect data quality issues, and visualize your findings? Are you highly customer-focused with excellent attention to detail?

About Darkroom
Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. We’re looking for a visionary creative leader with deep experience in developing ad concepts for digital paid media advertising formats on Meta, TikTok, and other channels. You are hyper-focused on paid media performance and developing advertisements that sell products and services.

You will work on our Performance Creative service—our AI-powered creative strategy engagement for paid media clients that want to work with us on the following:

  • Expertise: Engage us for our expertise in creative strategy, assessing the efficacy of ad hooks, ad bodies, and general creative direction, with a clear perspective on how to improve this over time.

This role is for individuals who want to be at the forefront of digital advertising, AI in marketing, and join a team building a world-class creative advertising culture. You will work directly on our Creative Team and collaborate with our Social Commerce and Paid Media teams. Your work will be the lifeblood of our ad programs.

What you’ll do

  • Creative Strategy: Lead high-tempo creative strategy and direction for full-funnel ad programs, typically Meta and TikTok, and also YouTube, Amazon, and Display Platforms.
  • Short Form Video Expert: Deliver expert advice, concepts, directions, and briefs to sell products and services through short-form video.
  • Data Analysis: Translate client’s marketing strategy and performance data into ad concepts (metrics include thumb-stop rate, hold rate, CTR; adapt creatives to impact these metrics).
  • Cross-Team Collaboration: Brief Designers and Editors on asset creation (static ads, animations, mobile-first videos, storyboards). Capable of contributing directly in design tools if needed.
  • Executive Presentation: Present creative work to stakeholders and clients with clarity and strategic rationale.
  • Performance Iteration: Monitor performance data with the marketing team to inform creative iterations and improve results over time.

You should apply if this sounds like you

  • 3+ years of creative strategy work on performance ad programs with a focus on short-form video and static ads. If you have not produced short-form video or driven creative strategy on Meta, this role is not for you.
  • A digital portfolio showing performance ad work that includes short-form video, motion, and static assets with impact metrics.
  • Ability to storyboard, cut, and ship ads; proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite.
